description: Generate a GoreBox Lua mod that discovers all available API functions, globals, tables, and callbacks. Writes results to a dump file in the mod folder. Use this when you need to learn what Lua API is available in a game that uses Lua scripting.

mod_name.description: Name for the discovery mod (default: APIDisco)

mods_dir.description: Path to the game Mods directory (e.g. C:/Users/.../GoreBox/Mods)

name: gorebox_generate_discovery_mod
